method: Independent visual inspection of the owner sheet and six Cycles captures made from reimported production GLBs. The side, front and rear projections are orthographic. Camera vectors, output dimensions and exposure settings are in generate.py.
reviewer: Independent visual review agent, separate from model authoring
revisions: Reduced the far soffit and bezel tessellation to bring the far LOD below 1,500 triangles.
Replaced the first repeated crescent motif with finer branching botanical enamel. Added a warm return lens, revised rear lighting and detailed the rear flanges and rivets.

observations.enclosure: The green enamel field, stepped brass header, mitred trim and three recessed warm lamps are distinguishable in hero, front and side views.
observations.type: The seven raised serif glyphs read New Moon, with pale-gold caps and thin brass edges.
observations.moon: The inset botanical pattern branches throughout the illuminated crescent. Its raised edge is visible in the three-quarter view.
observations.mounting: All four keyhole straps are visible against the charcoal rear plate.
observations.far: Both the wordmark and the crescent silhouette survive the flat bake.
observations.interpretation: Sprigs are more regular, the luminous halo tighter, and letter highlights softer than in the owner sheet.
